name: claim audit, subcontractors paid per call in USDC (Independent AI, checks by Attested Memory)
description: Independent AI audits a claim by hiring Attested Memory and paying it per call in USDC on Base — no account at Attested, nothing prepaid. Inside your job it buys Attested's claim.check@v1 and contradiction.scan@v1 on Attested's own hub (hub.attestedmemory.net), pays each on chain from Independent's wallet, and answers with both signed findings, a combined verdict (inconsistent when the statements contradict each other, otherwise Attested's status) and the two payment transactions. The price covers the checks ($0.031) and the gas; no allowance is needed.

evidence.description: As Attested's claim.check@v1 takes it: {source_uri, excerpt_hash (sha256:<hex>), stance supports|refutes|context, quality 0..1}

statements.description: Statements to scan for contradictions (lexical negation)

attested.description: Attested's claim_check and contradiction_scan answers, verbatim
